// silvernebula repository

Add the SilverNebula repo to any Arch system

Install SilverArch tools (silverpurge, silvergrab, silverflux) straight from pacman. Works on Arch Linux, ArchARM and Arch-based distros.

01 — OPEN PACMAN CONFIG

Edit /etc/pacman.conf

Open the file with root privileges.

terminal 
sudo nano /etc/pacman.conf
02 — ADD THE REPOSITORY

Append the silvernebula block

Start with the trust level set to Optional, then install the keyring.

pacman.conf 
[silvernebula]
SigLevel = Optional TrustAll
Server   = https://raw.githubusercontent.com/s1lverarch/silvernebula/main/$arch
03 — SYNC & INSTALL

Install the keyring, then the tools

After the keyring is installed, switch to SigLevel = Required DatabaseOptional.

terminal 
sudo pacman -Sy silvernebula-keyring
sudo pacman -Syu
sudo pacman -S silverpurge silvergrab silverflux
// origin story

Built for the World.

SilverArch Linux started as a personal project by Silvercore, a Linux distribution engineer from Tunisia who wanted an Arch-based system tuned for real-world performance, not theoretical benchmarks.

It grew into the first Arabic Tunisian Arch-based distribution with a truly international audience, supported by a multilingual community of Arabic, English and Russian speakers.

Did you know? SilverArch is the first Arabic indie Arch-based distribution.
Packages are not pre-installed. Only silverarch-installer and the keyring. You are the owner of the system.
Not affiliated with or endorsed by the Arch Linux project.
